title: Invertibility of the identity plus a small bounded operator
statement: Over the usual field $\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field], let $E$ be a complex vector space with a norm such that $\|av\|=|a|\|v\|$ and every Cauchy sequence converges. Let $T:E\to E$ be complex-linear and bounded, and write $\|T\|=\sup_{\|v\|\leq1}\|T(v)\|$ for its operator norm. If $\|T\|<1$, the map $I+T:E\to E$, $v\mapsto v+T(v)$, is bijective. The zero vector space is allowed.
